dataCollected.what: One record per request: a request id, the method, the URL path, the response status, size and duration, the HTTP protocol version, and the W3C trace and parent-span ids when the request carries a well-formed traceparent
dataCollected.purpose: Operating the site; no client address, query string, user agent or cookie is recorded

thirdParties.purpose: The area map: the page embeds a Google Maps frame, and the map buttons point it at nearby places
thirdParties.reason: The frame has no address until the visitor asks for the map with "Show the map" or a place button, so Google is contacted, and can set its own cookies, only on that request; the privacy notice says so (owner decision, issue #2, option 2)

thirdParties.purpose: The same area map: maps.google.com redirects the frame to www.google.com, which serves it
thirdParties.reason: The frame's real origin after the redirect, contacted only after the same visitor request as maps.google.com

edgeObservations.reason: The edge appends a bot-detection loader to every HTML response; this origin's CSP blocks it, so it never runs. Keeping or disabling it is an owner decision.
The edge adds NEL and Report-To headers, so browsers send network-error reports to the edge provider. Naming it in a privacy notice or disabling it is an owner decision.

The edge's free Web Analytics injects its beacon as an external script on every HTML response. This origin's CSP admits scripts from 'self' only, so the browser neither fetches nor runs it and nothing is collected from visitors through it. The owner decided on 2026-11-02 to keep it as it is.

handOffs.carries: The booking message the visitor composed (dates, guests and room) or a question about one room, in the visitor's language
handOffs.purpose: Booking and room questions go to the business over WhatsApp
handOffs.reason: Nothing is sent to this site; the message reaches WhatsApp only when the visitor presses a booking link or submits the form, and WhatsApp's own terms apply from there

handOffs.carries: The same booking message, with a subject line, addressed to the business's public email
handOffs.purpose: The booking form's email button opens the visitor's own mail client
handOffs.reason: Nothing is sent to this site; the visitor's mail client opens with the message and sends nothing until the visitor does
